parameters.body:
={
  "model": "llama-3.3-70b-versatile",
  "messages": [
    {
      "role": "system",
      "content": "You are a legal document analyzer specializing in South African real estate lease agreements. Extract all key terms accurately and return ONLY valid JSON."
    },
    {
      "role": "user",
      "content": "Analyze this lease agreement and extract key terms:\
\
LEASE TEXT:\
" + $json.lease_text + "\
\
Extract and return JSON:\
{\
  \"parties\": {\
    \"landlord\": \"name\",\
    \"tenant\": \"name\",\
    \"agent\": \"name\"\
  },\
  \"property\": {\
    \"address\": \"full address\",\
    \"type\": \"house/apartment/etc\"\
  },\
  \"financial\": {\
    \"monthly_rent\": 0,\
    \"deposit\": 0,\
    \"escalation_percent\": 0,\
    \"payment_date\": \"day of month\"\
  },\
  \"duration\": {\
    \"start_date\": \"YYYY-MM-DD\",\
    \"end_date\": \"YYYY-MM-DD\",\
    \"renewal_terms\": \"description\"\
  },\
  \"clauses\": {\
    \"pets_allowed\": true|false,\
    \"maintenance_responsibility\": \"landlord|tenant|split\",\
    \"subletting_allowed\": true|false,\
    \"early_termination\": \"terms\"\
  },\
  \"risk_assessment\": {\
    \"level\": \"low|medium|high\",\
    \"concerns\": [\"list any issues\"],\
    \"missing_clauses\": [\"standard clauses not present\"]\
  },\
  \"compliance\": {\
    \"fica_referenced\": true|false,\
    \"popia_referenced\": true|false,\
    \"consumer_protection_act\": true|false\
  }\
}"
    }
  ],
  "temperature": 0.1,
  "max_tokens": 2048,
  "response_format": {
    "type": "json_object"
  }
}
